column1: # Stage S11b, agent J3d1 — the building-blueprint compiler leaves developer_tools.
# developer_tools' blueprint module becomes the blueprint_compiler crate under tools/map_assets,
# with its test fixtures. The module root's code (the `blueprint-from-voxels` command) becomes
# the blueprint_from_voxels module; each source category folder takes its own tests/ folder,
# named after the module the tests exercise. The crate root, the category module files, the
# error module, the prelude, the shared test fixture module and the renames of the module
# aliases to their file names are written by hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the module root's command becomes its own module; the folder becomes the crate's sources
# the tests sit beside the category folder of the module they exercise
# the blueprint, prefab and world-parity inputs the unit tests read
# the moved code names its own crate
